source_owned_premises.typed_degree_one_frame: E_P3=direct_sum_{a=1}^7 L_a with ordered one-dimensional source-owned role lines
source_owned_premises.complete_pointed_boolean_closure: every subset S of {1,...,7}, including the empty root, is an occupied admissible exterior word; no face is bypassed
source_owned_premises.oriented_insertion_deletion: epsilon_a inserts role a with the source order sign and iota_a=epsilon_a^dagger deletes it
source_owned_premises.faithful_hodge_realization: the complete body map preserves the pointed exterior carrier, its positive Hodge metric, and all seven colored incidences
source_owned_premises.record_completion: the independently typed binary record factor is tensored once and does not duplicate seed alternatives

conditional_theorem.name: seed Boolean CAR refinement
conditional_theorem.conclusion: the seven colored incidences give the full CAR_7 star algebra, recover the frozen P3 Clifford generators and exterior number operator, and reproduce the 256-dimensional exterior-record carrier

nonentailment_theorem.name: global boundary decomposition no-go
nonentailment_theorem.statement: one global MVP boundary partial, even together with its adjoint, Hodge Laplacian and exterior number operator, does not select the seven typed colored incidences
nonentailment_theorem.countermodel: a nontrivial orthogonal rotation on the six-plane perpendicular to the all-ones boundary direction fixes partial, its Laplacian, N_ext and the CAR relations while changing every rotated typed mode

face_completeness_theorem.statement: removing an allowed Boolean face while retaining compressed insertions/deletions violates a diagonal CAR identity; a general non-total order complex therefore does not imply the full P3 CAR_7 grammar

mvp_relation.what_MVP_SHRCHAINCLOSE1_supplies: one transported nonzero nilpotent alternating boundary partial=N_s
mvp_relation.what_it_does_not_supply: the source-owned seven-color decomposition, full Boolean face completion, and typed faithful Hodge realization
mvp_relation.exact_bridge_condition: MVP-to-P3 CAR refinement holds exactly on the declared class when the occupied seed complex is the complete pointed oriented Boolean closure of the seven typed role lines and the base realizes each colored incidence faithfully

source_freeze_payload.exact_remaining_source_datum: prove from the physical base-seed action that the occupied seven-role seed owns the complete pointed oriented Boolean closure and its seven colored incidences, not merely their uncolored sum N_s
